text:
Mateo: Hey team — found a stack of sticky notes on the west whiteboard. All one-liners. Who's running the 'mandatory cheer-up quota'? :laughing:
Jules: Guilty. Left them after the 3pm retrofit meeting. Figured the whiteboard needed personality. :seedling:
Priya: The 'Why did the cache cross the road' one was peak engineering comedy, 10/10. :rofl:
Ava: Ooh we should vote. Winner gets a free iced coffee from the kitchen stash. @Jules are you up for being the judge? :coffee:
InfraBot: Poll created: https://polls.company/abcd — options: Cache joke / Kubernetes knock-knock / NullPointer lament. Voting open for 30m.
Mateo: Voted. Also @Jules, kudos for morale boost :clap: (reaction :thumbsup: by Priya)
Jules: Thanks! If my joke wins I'll bring pastries tomorrow morning. :croissant:
Priya: Also, tiny PSA — if you find sticky notes stuck on the projector, that's probably my keyboard's dramatic revenge for someone borrowing my `stapler` last week. :mag:
Ava: Stapler thief reveal at next town hall? I volunteer as detective. :detective:
Mateo: Love this. Low-effort, high-smiles. Carry on and may the best dad joke win. :trophy:
